en: A sepia-toned winter scene showing a building heavily covered with snow and ice, situated at the foot of a sizeable snowy mountain. There is a path leading toward the building, and several snow-encrusted poles or trees line the way. The building appears to be of unique architectural style, likely alpine or Central European, and there is a notable structure visible on top of the mountain in the background. The text at the bottom is partially legible and reads 'Schneekoppe ...'.
